games.name: A Day in the Life of a Beautiful Office Lady Follow Her from Morning to Night
games.summary:
From waking up in the morning to work and winding down at night, how much can you remember from a single day?

Take a close look at photographs following a beautiful office worker through her everyday routine, then put your memory to the test after just one minute.

The rules are simple!

・Study each photograph carefully for one minute
・Remember the person, her belongings and the surrounding details
・Answer the questions using your memory and choose from four options

You may think you noticed everything, only to wonder, “What was that like again?” when the question appears.

Enjoy scenes from the daily commute, moments at the office, lunchtime and a relaxing evening at home while testing your powers of recall.

Each challenge is short and easy to fit into a break or spare moment. Take a careful look at every corner of the photographs and see how accurately you can remember her day!

games.name: Air Hares
games.summary: Join the intrepid bunny pilot, Captain Rabbo, and her crew of fluffy flyers as they fight to turn the barren Winrose Warren into a blossoming landscape! Become an Air Hare in a unique take on bullet hells, restoring farmland one seed at a time, against the nefarious Gale Gang goons!

games.name: BEYOND THE EVIL
games.summary:
Pennsylvania, 2019. Gary Nephew, one private investigator got one strange call in the morning at his apartment from one supposed person dying and got in charge of the investigation of the person's house. At the time of the investigation, he found the caller dead body and some important stuff to research the killer's fingerprints. After sending all the evidence to his partner Lukas Smith, Gary didn't even imagined what was coming by...

Beyond the Evil is an psychological horror game that places the player to a hard experience to find who created one supposed plague that might doom the world.

games.name: Choice of Life: Floors
games.summary:
Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape... or to madness

Use the items you find, fight the creatures of your mind, embrace the absurdity of your situation, and decide: will you escape this nightmare, or drown in it forever?

A dark story told with irony and humor, heightening both the absurdity of the events and the fragility of the human mind. Sometimes, laughing at horror is the only way to cope.

games.name: Cosplay Beauties Best Shot Puzzle
games.summary:
Can you bring a scattered photograph back together?

You have seen pictures like these before, but can you spot how every piece should connect?

Rotate the pieces to complete stylish portraits of cosplay beauties in angelic, fairy-inspired, maid-style and futuristic outfits.

The rules are simple:
・Check the pieces in the photograph
・Select a piece with the wrong orientation and rotate it
・Line up every piece correctly to finish the picture

A handy hint is available when you get stuck, making it easy to keep going even if you are new to puzzles.

Enjoy the satisfaction of watching each photograph take shape, then admire the finished best shot. It is ideal for a quick break, a little downtime or a thoughtful solo puzzle session.

Can you complete every stage and finish your favourite pictures?

games.name: Exorcist - Guns of Heaven
games.summary:
Fast-paced rogue-like FPS chaos against deadly monsters!

This fast-paced, rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a chaotic nightmare where twisted monsters lurk around every corner — relentless, ravenous, and out for blood.

Start each run by customizing your experience with unique modifiers: crank up the difficulty and tweak the rules to shape your run your way. Then pick your unlocked arena — from The Bouncy Castle to Candy World or even outer space — each with its own hazards and interactive traps.

Armed with only a pistol, you'll face waves of monsters that charge, dash, fly, shoot, shield themselves, explode, and overwhelm you with sheer numbers. Kill them, collect glowing experience orbs, and level up to choose from powerful upgrades. Will you improve your damage, speed, or reload time? Unlock stronger weapons? Or summon explosive chaos to wipe out swarms at once? Every decision shapes your survival run.

As the arena fills with charging, exploding, and bullet-spewing monsters, the game becomes a frantic dance of dodging, aiming, and managing your ammo while exploiting map hazards like explosive sweets or damaging zones to survive longer. The further you go, the crazier it gets — until you're finally overwhelmed. But every run earns progress, new arenas, and more chaos for your next rampage.

Do you have what it takes to survive the monster apocalypse?

games.name: For Ages 10 and Up! My First Code Logic Quiz ~ IQ Pattern Quizzes to Train Logical Thinking ~
games.summary:
What rule is hiding in the sequence? Look closely at the puzzle and work out what should come next!

Numbers, shapes and arrangements all hold clues. This IQ pattern quiz invites you to think, compare and find the logic behind each question.

Getting started is easy!
• Study the image carefully
• Think about the hidden rule or sequence
• Choose the answer you think is correct

There is no need to memorise complicated programming code. Organising an order, finding a shared rule and predicting what comes next are all ways to enjoy logical thinking in a fun quiz format.

The key is not simply what you know, but what you notice. Take your time and enjoy that satisfying moment when the answer finally clicks.

Recommended for anyone who:
• Is curious about programming logic
• Enjoys IQ quizzes and logic puzzles
• Likes spotting patterns and sequences
• Enjoys thinking and solving problems
• Wants to tackle puzzles with family
• Would like a quick mental workout

How many patterns can you uncover? Put your intuition and logic to the test with a range of IQ pattern quizzes!

games.name: Hot Spring Beauties Japanese Inn Date Memory
games.summary:
Memorize the perfect ryokan moment! A quick photo memory challenge How many details can you remember?

Take a good look at photos set in a relaxing Japanese hot spring inn and try to remember every detail before time runs out!

From open-air baths and cozy guest rooms to elegant lounges and peaceful gardens, each scene is packed with details worth remembering.

How to play:
・Study the photo before time runs out
・Remember the people, poses, clothing, and objects around them
・Use your memory to take on the challenge

The simple gameplay makes it easy to jump in for a quick session. Enjoy the photos at your own pace while putting your memory and observation skills to the test.

Recommended for players who:
・Enjoy photo and memory games
・Like testing their observation skills
・Love Japanese inns and hot spring scenery
・Want something easy to play in short sessions
・Enjoy relaxing, glamorous photography

How much of each scene can you remember?

games.name: Hundred Fires: OPEN VECTOR - Episode 1
games.summary: Infiltrate, fight and cut your way through secret facilities in an alternate Cold War. Play as Merche, a guerrilla and thief armed with a katana capable of slicing through enemies and the environment, and uncover the secrets behind mysterious Ancient Weapons.

games.name: Joe & Mac Retro Collection
games.summary:
Developed by Red Art Studios, Red Art Games' internal development studio, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a compilation of Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja, Congo's Caper, and Joe & Mac 2: Lost in the Tropics, the three Joe & Mac titles developed by Data East and released on Super Nintendo between 1991 and 1995. 

In addition to allowing players to rediscover the original games as they were presented back in the 90s, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection also features numerous quality of life improvements!

games.name: Kowloon's Gate Suzaku
games.summary:
The legendary, surreal Asian-gothic game set in a Kowloon-inspired world is reborn on Nintendo Switch™.

Kowloon’s Gate Suzaku is the ultimate walking simulator, reimagining the world of the 1997 classic, Kowloon’s Gate.

Set as a prequel, the game invites you to wander the maze-like alleys of the Walled City and soak in the atmosphere of a town steeped in memory—offering perspectives and locations never seen in the original.

Your goal is simple: use photos from a found album as clues to locate specific spots, and bring those memories back to life through psychography.

Rerendered in higher detail, these familiar places and nostalgia-inducing characters are waiting for you.

What memories will be brought back? Step in, and see for yourself.

games.name: Love Love Mystery Club
games.summary: In Love Love Mystery Club, you’re the newest member of the Detective Club at a seemingly ordinary high school. Through Full Motion Video (FMV) storytelling, your choices steer the narrative—will your heart find tenderness… or will hidden horrors emerge from the darkness?

games.name: Masters of Art: 19th-Century French Painting Quiz
games.summary:
Ever wondered what lies beyond the frame?

Explore the fascinating stories and little-known facts behind 19th-century French paintings in this entertaining four-choice quiz. Discover the hidden side of works by the era’s celebrated masters while enjoying a quick, approachable way to learn.

How to play:
・Study the image carefully
・Choose one answer from four options
・Read the detailed explanation after a correct answer
・Use a hint when you need a little help

You do not need to be an art expert. Whether you enjoy visiting galleries, love masterpieces and trivia, or simply want a quick quiz to play, there is plenty to discover. Learn something new, test your knowledge and enjoy the fascinating background behind great French painting.

Fancy putting your art knowledge to the test?

games.name: Meiji Tokyo Renka: Twilight Kiss
games.summary:
"Meiji Tokyo Renka" (also known as "Meikoi") is a historical romance fantasy game in which the main character travels back in time to the Meiji era and meets—and falls in love with—great figures from history.

This is the story of Mei, a high school girl who suddenly finds herself transported through time to a mysterious version of Meiji-era Tokyo, where supernatural beings known as mononoke roam. There, she becomes romantically involved with famous historical figures from the era.
These sweet yet dramatic stories, centered on the male leads and their relationships with Mei, pick up where the last game left off. As the characters face new incidents caused by mononoke, their bonds deepen, unfolding into richly emotional and romantic tales.

New romances with historical figures unfold in a slightly mysterious version of Meiji-era Tokyo, now brought to life in high definition.
The game also includes one of its signature features: 3D Love Voice. These immersive voice performances enhance the romantic scenes with each character.

games.name: Melting Attacker
games.summary:
A simple and easy-to-play action game! Take control of Melt the slime and defeat enemies by charging into them!

Simply touching an enemy will either deal damage or cause you to take damage.
Defeat as many enemies as possible and increase your score!

Use Try Melt to break rocks and earn money.
When you're in a pinch, spend your money to summon a greenish slime helper!

Sometimes, a glowing rock will appear.
When it does, it's Invincibility Mode! Enjoy the exhilarating feeling of wiping out blue slimes for 30 seconds!

Stage 2 features branching paths!
Each stage offers a different, dramatic experience.

Survive for 5 minutes or defeat the boss to move forward.
Play again and again to beat your high score, or clear all 7 stages!

games.name: Mystery Room - Crime Scene Tap Detective -
games.summary:
A crime scene can hide the smallest detail. Do you have what it takes to notice what feels out of place?

Take a close look at illustrated crime scenes and tap suspicious locations to uncover clues. This casual mystery game challenges your observation and deduction skills as you work toward the truth.

Getting started is easy!
• Read the situation and question
• Examine the scene illustration carefully
• Tap the location that seems suspicious

Where is the clue that connects everything? Ordinary objects, unusual behavior, and subtle details may all hold the key to solving the case.

You only need to choose the spot that catches your attention, so anyone can enjoy the challenge—even if you do not usually play detective games.

Think through each scene on your own, or compare theories with family and friends. The quick-to-play format is perfect for a short break whenever you want to test your powers of observation and deduction.

Can you uncover the decisive clue hidden at the scene? Solve every mystery and get closer to the truth!

games.name: Olivia
games.summary: Once a family home, now stands silent. The past still whispers through every room. You are looking for inspiration for a film, but you will find much more than just a story. Whether the lights are on or off... it doesn't matter. Olivia will find you.

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

games.name: Smithsonian: Planets and the Solar System
games.summary:
An interactive space adventure where young explorers discover the planets, uncover fascinating facts, and learn through play in a safe, engaging experience designed for curious kids.

Join us on an exciting voyage through the solar system!
Designed for curious minds, this app features brilliantly illustrated animations which are sure to engage and entertain.
Why is Mars called the Red Planet? Which is the brightest Planet? How many moons does Neptune have? What is the Asteroid Belt? Explore Planets, learn facts, and play games as you rocket through the solar system. Your space enthusiast will love learning all about the wonders of space and the universe. The mini games reinforce the learning and interactive activities will keep kids engaged.

games.name: Souls of Bombarika
games.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
games.summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Jump into an escape room set in a deranged mind and experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives and attempt to unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller. Project yourself into a riveting narrative experience and become immersed in an unsettling psychological thriller. Piece together a family's mystery as you recover fragmented memories from the corrupted consciousness of each perspective. In this first-person narrative mystery, you must explore the walls of the family's home to interpret events and discover the truth. Playable in VR and non-VR modes.

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary:
Welcome to Titanium Court! Table for one? You have a reservation I assume? You don’t!? Ah, I see. Just minding your own business before stumbling into a realm of magic and faeries, were you? Not to worry, happens all the time. Tell you what, why don’t I see if we can squeeze you in somewhere while you become acquainted with the many amenities offered by the Court.

Amenities such as:

Puzzling Battles: For tonight's entertainment, the Court is at WAR! Just a little something to pass the time, you see. Who's in command? Why do you ask? Are you volunteering? Oh don't worry, you won't be issuing orders to these faerie troops. They wouldn't follow them anyways. I think you'll have more success commanding the terrain itself to fall in your favor, haha.

Puzzling Narrative: Lore dumps are strictly against my religion I'm afraid, so you'll have to uncover the secrets of the Court yourself. Some of them may even fundamentally change you as a person. Be careful with those!

Diverse and fulfilling career options: Warlord, Arsonist, Celebrity, Insurance Fraudster. Your time within the Court will qualify you for many of these exalted and lucrative positions.

games.name: Zombie Bullets - Dead Zone
games.summary: Zombie Bullets - Dead Zone the game

games.name: Asylum
games.summary:
ASYLUM is an ambitious and intricate first-person horror adventure casting you into the hallucinatory setting of the Hanwell Mental Institute. Interact with its curious denizens, gather clues, unravel the mystery, and march towards a shocking conclusion.

With influences ranging from Lovecraft to Peter Cushing to Lucio Fulci, ASYLUM has been meticulously crafted with a strong focus on storytelling and atmosphere. Explore countless tenebrous environments, make your way through a towering, lifelike mental hospital, and solve compelling puzzles to find the answers you seek.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.name: Distorted - Paranormal Activities
games.summary:
A psychological horror game as paranormal investigator.

People leave traces when they go. Some leave more than that.
In Distorted – Paranormal Activities, you are commissioned to investigate an old apartment building that was quietly evacuated after a series of incidents no official report has satisfactorily explained. Your assignment is straightforward: visit each day, walk the floors, check the units, and determine whether what is happening inside is genuinely supernatural.
The building receives you with the particular stillness of a place that used to be full of life. Doormats still outside flats. A child's drawing taped to a hallway wall. Furniture left exactly as it stood on the last morning people were here.
But something lingers. A door left open that was closed. A name scratched into a wall that doesn't match any resident record. A figure standing at the far end of a corridor that isn't there when you reach it.
Each day follows the same procedure: Move through the building, observe what has changed, and trust what you remember. If something unnatural has occurred, you must place a cleansing marker in the building's old boiler room before leaving. If the day seems undisturbed, you return home and come back tomorrow.
But your judgment matters. Leave a marker on a quiet day, or leave without one when something was truly there — and the investigation starts to collapse.

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary:
With his home world on the brink of ecological collapse, Maxwell bravely hopped into his experimental ship in dogged pursuit of a solution.

Beyond the point of no return, holding out forlorn hope, he finds himself stranded - thousands of lightyears from home, at the edge of a hostile galaxy.

Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.

Goodboy Galaxy is a game in development for Game Boy Advance, PC and Nintendo Switch. It's an exploration focused platform game similar to Metroid or Cave Story.

games.name: Look Outside
games.summary:
Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters - human and otherwise. 

Survival Horror & Resource Management
Plan tense expeditions outside your apartment as you fend off grotesque monsters dwelling in and around your building. Return to your home with gathered resources and partial answers to your questions to recuperate by playing games, making dinner, crafting tools, and getting to know your neighbors turned allies. 

Inventive Turn-Based Combat
Clash with over 150 hand-crafted creatures in turn-based combat that accounts for space between you and your foes as you wield makeshift weapons and items you've gathered in the corridors of the building. 

Impeccable Body Horror Aesthetic
Meet your macabre fate in a bizarre world teeming with an unconventional and occasionally psychotic cast of characters - some of which you can recruit and offer safe harbor in your apartment as the mystery unravels. 

Small, Experimental, and Unwaveringly Weird
Offering 10 - 12 hours of playtime with a dozen boss encounters, friends to recruit, and visitors to invite back to your home, Look Outside offers different experiences for every player on their way to uncover several different endings.

games.name: Pinballoid Crush
games.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

games.name: Retro Video Store Simulator
games.summary:
Build your retro store and bring classic nostalgia back to life.

Step into a stylish 90s-inspired city and take charge of your own retro store. In this first-person business simulator, buy nostalgic products, organize your shelves, serve customers, and transform a small shop into a successful local business filled with classic media and vintage technology.

Order new stock, unpack deliveries, arrange your products, and keep your customers happy. Use your profits to expand your selection, purchase new equipment, improve your store layout, and add decorative touches that capture the authentic atmosphere of the 90s. Every improvement brings more customers, more opportunities, and a bigger business.

Key Features:
• Run Your Retro Store: Manage daily operations, serve customers, and grow your business.
• Stock Classic Products: Sell VHS tapes, video players, cameras, vinyl records, magazines, comics, and retro electronics.
• Unpack & Organize: Receive deliveries, unpack your products, and arrange them throughout your store.
• Grow Your Business: Use your profits to unlock new products, equipment, shelves, and upgrades.
• Customize Your Store: Create a unique 90s atmosphere with neon signs, posters, vintage lamps, and retro decorations.

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary:
Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 & Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride.

Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then ‘Find the Cat’ will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from.

But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone.

Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
games.summary:
The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! 

Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

games.name: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection
games.summary:
The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal - Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: HorrorVale
games.summary:
Welcome to HorrorVale! Your next door neighbors are zombies, reanimated monsters deliver the mail and ghosts hide out in your bathroom. Join Alice as she journeys through the underworld on a quest to save her zombie Dog, Scruffy from strange and unusual monsters that have suddenly invaded the once peaceful town of HorrorVale.

HorrorVale is a traditional RPG adventure game inspired by horror, full of unexpected twists and turns.

games.name: Innocent Memory
games.summary:
The protagonist, Seiichi Makita, suddenly finds himself lost in an unknown world—a mysterious place free from all the injustices of ordinary life. Humans, animals, and plants alike are free to live as they wish in this seemingly ideal world.

Having lost most of his memories, Seiichi sets out in search of a way back to his own world alongside Yuki, a cat-eared girl he meets there. As their journey continues, fragments of his lost memories gradually begin to return. And beyond them lies a truth Seiichi could never have imagined...

games.name: Neverway
games.summary:
After Fiona quits her job, she starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. 

Keep your life from falling apart while searching for Neverway, a nightmare reality that is slowly leaking into yours.

Neverway features a top-down, fast-paced combat with an emphasis on player expression. Craft items to customize your playstyle, and unlock combat abilities through your friendship bonds.

Farm and craft items, prepare meals, or just decorate your homestead. Time progresses in three blocks, and you choose when to advance: morning, afternoon, and evening. One day at a time.

games.name: SUPER ARROW SHOT
games.summary:
Can you defeat your enemies before they have time to react?

SUPER ARROW SHOT is a minimalist first-person archery action game where time moves only when you do. Enter a frozen world where enemies stand still, arrows hang in the air, and every movement can change the outcome of a battle. Study your surroundings, plan your next move, and strike before your enemies have a chance to react.

Take control of every encounter with precise archery and tactical movement. Find the perfect position, predict incoming attacks, use the environment to your advantage, and eliminate your targets one by one.

games.name: Tarot Tokens
games.summary:
Tarot Tokens is a strategic tile game inspired by the Fools journey through the major arcana of the tarot. Placing Tarot Tokens crafts your journey from four key aspects of the major arcana of the tarot: family, morals, conflict, hope.

The aim of Tarot Tokens is to build your three virtues up and keep them nicely balanced by making wise, or seemingly foolish choices, along the way. Run out of any virtue and the journey ends. Reach the end by taking all the steps and reflect on your journey - learn to see pass the numbers and embrace your whole journey.

games.name: Cat President 2: Purrlitical Revolution
games.summary: The cats are back to win your heart—and your vote!

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

games.name: Let's Sing 2027
games.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

games.name: Outbreak: Dead City
games.summary: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colourful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Cluedo Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Pretty Girls Game Collection V
games.summary:
The latest entry in the popular compilation series brings together four fan-favourite Pretty Girls titles in one value-packed retail release, offering players a diverse selection of puzzle and casual gameplay experiences paired with the charming anime-style presentation that fans have come to expect from the franchise.

Each of the four games has been enhanced with exclusive naughty content, that fans of the series have become accustomed to, amounting to a wealth of new images direct from the Japanese creators that would otherwise not have been possible to release on console even in their home country, making this essential and definitive.

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary:
Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. 

But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. 

Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary:
Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge.

Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt.

games.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished
games.summary: Turn pain into power with The Punished, a new clan joining the fight in Monster Train 2! Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished introduce a new risk-reward play style built around damaging your own units, harnessing their suffering, and turning it against your enemies.

games.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
games.summary:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary:
Castlebound is a thrilling roguelike action game where you and your allies must defend a walking castle while battling relentless waves of monstrous foes.

Join Lenora, a skilled archer, and her wise grandfather Vargus as they awaken an ancient structure that transforms into a living fortress.

Guided by the enigmatic Coronya, they must gather powerful warriors to fight the malevolent forces threatening the realm.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary:
Dive into a story-driven survival-horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. 

A miracle crop designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. It twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, hollowed out by a chemical addiction and driven by primal hunger. 

Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safe haven. But their journey draws the attention of the Pastor and his mysterious following. He sees remaining humans not as people, but as fertile soil for his plans.

Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution: every door can lead to salvation… or devastation.

Protect Ava at all costs. The world can die, but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a hostile wilderness that wants you gone. No one is coming to save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.
